description_en: Retrieves the QPS limit for file uploads configured by the user
description_zh: 获取用户设置的上传文件QPS
name: GetFileUploadLimit

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder (Alibaba Cloud account).
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

Data.description_en: The data returned if the call is successful
Data.description_zh: 接口调用成功时，返回的数据

Limit.description_en: The configured QPS limit for file uploads

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
RequestId.name: RequestId
